title: Grid cell stacking: Vec<ComponentId> with stacking_limit
description:
Change grid cell model from Option<ComponentId> to Vec<ComponentId> with a per-zone stacking_limit. Default limit = 1 (backward compatible, all existing games unchanged).

Patterns supported:
- Vertical stacking (Hive beetles): LIFO, top piece active, below pinned
- Same-owner grouping (Backgammon): count matters, not individual identity
- Layered placement (Carcassonne): tile + meeple coexist

API:
- cell_top(zone, col, row) → top component (backward compat with cell_at)
- cell_stack(zone, col, row) → full stack as list
- cell_count(zone, col, row) → stack size
- stack_push(zone, col, row, component) → add to top (fails if at limit)
- stack_pop(zone, col, row) → remove from top

Schema: stacking_limit field on grid zones (already exists in schema, not enforced). Values: 1 (default), N (fixed limit), "unlimited".

Existing cell_at returns cell_top. Zero breaking changes for games with limit=1.

Deliverables: (1) Rust engine: Vec<ComponentId> per cell, limit enforcement. (2) Python engine: same. (3) Felt host imports: cell_top, cell_stack, cell_count. (4) Update Hive definition to use stacking. (5) Update Backgammon if beneficial. (6) Tests for push/pop/limit/backward compat.
design: Vec<ComponentId> per cell with stacking_limit. Default 1 = backward compatible. cell_at returns cell_top. LIFO stack semantics.
close_reason: Stacking integrated: stacking_limit parsed from definitions, grid_push/pop wired into place/move actions, limit enforced. Both engines. 304 Rust + 3496 Python tests passing.
